baseline_models.focus_anchor: The waiting verb at word 2, suddenness at word 7, prior arrival at words 9-10, and deferred reminder at word 15 form a before/after threshold.
baseline_models.mechanism: The audience grants response only to the main event while its preliminaries have already arrived. Suddenness therefore names the collapse of their chosen delay, and remembrance after arrival cannot substitute for response during the notice window.

activation_trace.role: The waiting-and-respite range makes the opening posture a chosen deferral rather than simple lack of information.
Expected arrival supplies the prospective event against which the audience postpones action.
Unanticipated encounter converts the postponed event into a threshold that affords no preparation.
Preliminary stages place real advance material before the event's main body.
A reminder restores an absent matter, but here restoration is deferred until after the operative threshold.

changed_reading.before: They merely wait for an Hour that will surprise them.
changed_reading.after: They defer response until the main event even though its preliminaries already supply notice; remembrance after the threshold cannot recover the lost interval for action.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 2 can denote directed perception, word 10 can denote a readable mark, and word 15 can denote recovery from forgetting.
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening question can diagnose a failed mode of seeing: they direct perception toward a future spectacle while overlooking marks already present. Their eventual recollection is not new evidence but recognition delayed until evidence has become consequence.

activation_trace.role: Directed sight or reflection turns apparent waiting into an evidential act that can succeed or fail.
A distinguishing mark makes the already-arrived material something available to recognition.
Recovery after forgetting explains the final reminder as belated recognition of previously available evidence.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts present ignorance with future information.
changed_reading.after: The information is already marked in the present; what changes later is not evidence but the audience's compelled recognition of it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The condition-or-mark at word 10, the interrogative at word 11, and the reminder at word 15 permit a procedural reading of the same temporal sequence.
baseline_models.mechanism: The arrived marks can function like conditions or notice, while the event reaches its due time. On this reading the final reminder resembles a claim or record presented only after the conditions have matured into execution, so its content may remain true while its practical force has expired.

activation_trace.role: The condition-and-mark range supplies the procedural notice on which this model turns.
Reaching ripeness or due time makes arrival the execution of a matured process.
The secondary mapping contributes an appointed interval, preserving the timing dimension across the split root.
A documentary record of a right lets the final reminder be tested as a procedurally late claim.

changed_reading.before: Their reminder is simply a thought that comes too late.
changed_reading.after: Their reminder can be carried as a valid notice or claim whose opportunity to alter the outcome has expired once the marked conditions reach execution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The looking root at word 2 and the sign root at word 10 both possess branches involving visible bodily effects or cuts.
baseline_models.mechanism: The signs need not all be external forecasts. They may be lesions, cuts, or visible changes already borne by the people who fail to read them, so catastrophe announces itself by altering its subjects before its full arrival.

activation_trace.role: A glance's visible effect in color or defect supplies an embodied surface on which hidden condition becomes legible.
An incision and the trace it leaves recast a sign as damage already inscribed on the subject.
Recollection after prior non-recognition explains why an embodied mark can remain unread until crisis.

changed_reading.before: The signs are external portents preceding the event.
changed_reading.after: Some signs may be present alterations in the observers themselves, legible before the event but recognized only when the damage becomes consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier command to travel and inspect destroyed predecessors supplies an already-visible archive of outcomes. The focus question then sounds less like neutral waiting and more like refusal to perform the kind of looking the surah has already required.

activation_trace.role: Reflective perception anchors the focus question in a cognitive task rather than bare chronology.
The same perception branch is explicitly directed toward observable historical evidence.
The terminal outcome gives inspection a temporal object that anticipates the focus verse's final threshold.
Comprehensive destruction makes prior consequences material evidence rather than an abstract warning.
An exemplary sign extends the inspected outcome toward analogous future cases.

structural_cues: 47:10 repeats the focus root ن ظ ر in an explicit travel-and-inspect construction before 47:18 asks what they are looking or waiting for.
The perfect prior arrival of the signs in 47:18 follows a historical outcome that has already been offered for inspection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commanded inspection, terminal outcomes, destruction, and analogy; I infer that refusing this archive turns later waiting into evidential evasion. A live alternative is that 47:10 only exemplifies punishment without revising the focus verb.

changed_reading.before: They passively await a future event for which they lack direct evidence.
changed_reading.after: They decline to inspect a supplied archive of analogous outcomes and then treat the final event as though only its direct arrival could count as evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The four rivers and the terminal heated water activate the focus roots' channels, incoming flood, pooled water, and small earth-course branches. The event can therefore be imagined as a distributed approach whose minor courses and accumulations are already present even though its eventual inundation feels sudden downstream.

Repeated flowing channels provide the context's dominant material system for the analogy.
Water's appearance and increase support a process that becomes visible before reaching full force.
The root's approach-and-presence range supplies temporal nearness inside the liquid scene.

structural_cues: 47:15 repeats four river constructions and ends with a harmful liquid immediately before the listening, guidance, and focus sequence.
Within 47:18 one arrival is already perfect while the other remains prospective, fitting upstream accumulation followed by downstream impact.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies channels, increasing water, nearness, a foreign flood, a pool, and an earth trace; I supply the directional arrow from small courses to accumulated inundation. A live alternative is that 47:15 is only a contrast of destinations and does not materialize the focus event's approach.

changed_reading.before: Sudden arrival means an event with no perceptible approach.
changed_reading.after: Suddenness may be downstream surprise within a process whose channels, traces, and accumulation have already arrived upstream.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding pair contrasts hearing that does not retain meaning with guidance that increases and is given further provision. This makes the final reminder path-dependent: crisis does not create a fresh cognitive capacity, but exposes whether earlier reception had been sealed or cumulatively enlarged.

activation_trace.role: Mental recovery anchors the question in whether prior content remains cognitively available at the deadline.
Hearing as understanding and compliance marks the receptive capacity that the listeners fail to realize.
A sealing impression turns repeated non-reception into a stabilized cognitive closure.

Growth makes receptivity cumulative rather than a single moment of recognition.
The secondary mapping casts that accumulation as provisions carried ahead of a transition.
Bestowal makes pre-crisis capacity something received and retained before the focus event arrives.

structural_cues: 47:16, 47:17, and 47:18 form an immediate sequence of failed retention, increased direction, and questioned late reminder.
The two groups diverge before the event: one asks what was just said, while the other receives an increase.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed meaningful hearing, sealing, growth, provision, and a late reminder; I infer a feedback path in which prior reception determines later recall's efficacy. A live alternative is that the verses describe separate groups without asserting a causal memory trajectory.

changed_reading.before: Anyone can remember effectively once the event forces attention.
changed_reading.after: The event exposes a capacity formed beforehand: earlier receptivity compounds into usable guidance, while repeated non-reception hardens into recall that arrives without efficacy.

context_deltas.mechanism: When decisive fighting is mentioned, the later verse shows diseased hearts already producing a visibly death-struck gaze. That scene functions as a local rehearsal of 47:18: mention arrives, bodily perception collapses, and death becomes experientially present before the final event.

activation_trace.role: A gaze that registers as bodily defect anchors the focus verb in an observable crisis response.
The rare association with the perished lets death color the temporal noun without replacing its ordinary force.
Overt mention is the local signal that precipitates the visible response.
The repeated gaze externalizes inner failure as pallor, defect, or altered appearance.
A condition that weakens action explains why perception does not become timely response.
A covering loss of consciousness models cognition overwhelmed at the moment it is most needed.
The split mapping reinforces that the covering specifically disables understanding.
Loss of life and force supplies the terminal state already simulated in their gaze.

structural_cues: 47:20 repeats root ن ظ ر twice just after the focus and explicitly compares the gaze with being overtaken by death.
The sequence moves from mention to seeing to bodily collapse, mirroring notice, arrival, and ineffective remembrance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mention, diseased hearts, altered gaze, cognitive covering, and death; I infer that this scene is a small-scale rehearsal of the focus threshold. A live alternative is that it is only an independent fear simile with no temporal rehearsal function.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a wholly future and unprecedented response.
changed_reading.after: Their response is already rehearsed whenever a decisive demand arrives: the body displays death-awareness while cognition and action fail, previewing the final reminder's uselessness.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the focus, the matter becomes resolved, reflection on outcomes is demanded, hearts appear locked, and some reverse after clarity while delay is extended. These cues convert the late-reminder problem into a closing decision window: postponement does not preserve neutrality but helps produce the lock that makes later recollection inert.

activation_trace.role: Slowness and delay anchor the audience's posture in extended postponement.
Recurring intervals in the secondary mapping make postponement a repeated pattern rather than one hesitation.
A matter decisively bound and cut establishes the point after which prior indecision becomes consequential.
Considering consequences names the timely cognitive work that should occur before closure.
Closure and hardening supply the mechanism by which available reminder ceases to enter.
Turning back after forward clarification gives postponement a directional reversal.
The split mapping adds a stripping away of good that hardens into rebellion, preserving a more severe account of reversal.
An extended span of time supplies the deceptive room in which reversal can settle.
The second mapped inventory confirms temporal extension as a live contribution rather than resolving the split away.

structural_cues: 47:21 introduces the point at which the matter is resolved, while 47:24 asks for prior reflection and 47:25 depicts reversal after clarification.
The progression from clarity to delay to closure supplies a temporal mechanism for why reminder at arrival lacks force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decisive resolution, consequence-oriented reflection, closure, reversal, and extended time; I infer that repeated delay helps cause the later lock. A live alternative is that the lock is a prior condition and delay merely reveals it rather than producing it.

changed_reading.before: Waiting leaves the audience free to decide later when evidence becomes conclusive.
changed_reading.after: Waiting consumes and reshapes the decision window: clarity can be reversed, delay can harden, and by conclusive arrival the capacity to use reminder may already be locked.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later interrogative scene depicts complete taking by angels and blows to front and back. It gives the focus's open arrival a personal terminal enactment: even if the Hour remains universal, its no-return threshold can reach each person through seizure and death.

activation_trace.role: Repeated coming links prior signs and terminal arrival in one approach structure.
Unexpected encounter supplies the irreversible surprise of the personalized threshold.
Complete taking of the self turns a general event into an individual point of no return.
Angelic agents give the taking scene an explicit executor.
Impact makes the threshold bodily immediate rather than merely conceptual.
The face-strike branch fixes the scene on the person's forward aspect.
The back completes the front-to-rear enclosure and leaves no directional escape.

structural_cues: 47:27 uses branchless ك ي ف at word 1 only as a structural echo of the focus's interrogative at word 11; no branch ID is supplied or invented.
Both verses place an interrogative before a temporal clause, but 47:27 fills the later clause with a concrete taking scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the interrogative echo, complete taking, angelic agency, and front-to-back impact; I infer that personal death instantiates the focus verse's irreversible deadline. A live alternative is that 47:27 concerns only one post-focus episode and should not narrow the universal Hour.

changed_reading.before: Only a single universal cosmic event can close the reminder window.
changed_reading.after: The universal event remains live, but the same no-return logic may be individually instantiated when a person is fully taken, so the practical deadline is not safely remote.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence moves from hidden rancor to recognition by visible marks and vocal inflection, then to testing that manifests inner news. This strongly activates the focus signs as diagnostic disclosures: what is coming is already leaving readable traces in persons and speech.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark anchors the focus signs in present diagnostic legibility.
A cut that leaves an effect lets the mark be produced by the very process it discloses.
Recognition from an effect or mark supplies the observer-side operation needed to read latent states.
A visible indication of condition turns appearance into evidence of what remains inward.
The second mapping retains the general function of a distinguishing mark across the root split.
Inflection toward implied meaning makes speech another surface on which the concealed state leaks out.
Testing that makes condition manifest supplies the causal production of readable evidence.
The parallel mapped inventory independently preserves manifestation through trial rather than collapsing the split.
Knowledge of inward reality names what the tests and marks bring to disclosure.

structural_cues: Branchless ض غ ن at 47:29 word 11 and 47:37 word 6 is used only as the structural cue of a concealed interior that is later brought out; no branch ID is invented.
47:29-31 orders concealment, visual and vocal recognition, and testing, forming an explicit latent-to-visible sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed interiority, marks, vocal leakage, testing, and knowledge of inward condition; I infer that these present disclosures can belong among the focus verse's already-arrived signs. A live alternative is that they identify local hypocrisy only and do not function as signs of the final event.

changed_reading.before: The signs are mainly external chronological portents.
changed_reading.after: The signs can also be present diagnostics: pressure makes latent allegiance visible in faces, speech, and tested conduct before the final arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing instructions warn against nullifying works and promise that works will not be docked. These accounting cues activate the focus reminder's documentary branch and the signs' conditional branch: remembrance at arrival resembles a record offered after the period in which conduct could preserve or cancel its claim.

activation_trace.role: A condition or mark gives conduct a procedural relation to the approaching settlement.
A documentary record of right lets remembrance carry an account-like force without requiring a literal legal document.
Cancellation supplies the possibility that an otherwise present work loses operative force.
Work linked to recompense gives the conduct an accountable consequence.
Loss that strips a right or work defines the negative accounting outcome explicitly denied to the responsive group.

structural_cues: 47:33 and 47:35 frame works as capable of cancellation yet also capable of being preserved without reduction.
That preserve-or-cancel contrast follows the focus verse's question about whether late reminder can still have practical effect.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditions, a right-record branch, cancellable work, recompense, and non-reduction; I infer a procedural account in which timely response preserves operative standing. A live alternative is ordinary moral accounting with no documentary nuance in the focus reminder.

changed_reading.before: Late reminder fails only because the audience feels regret too late.
changed_reading.after: Late reminder may also fail procedurally: the record can be true while arriving after the conduct window in which a claim was preserved or canceled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing characterization of near worldly life as aimless play and diversion supplies the occupation that sustains postponement. Waiting for direct arrival is therefore not empty time but attention continually reassigned to nearer objects until the signs can no longer redirect action.

activation_trace.role: Waiting anchors the behavioral delay that the later distractions explain.
Directed attention makes diversion a displacement of perception, not merely passage of time.
The nearer world supplies the immediately available object that competes with the remote-seeming threshold.
Activity without a sound end explains motion that consumes time without preparing for consequence.
Being occupied away from one thing by another supplies the direct attentional mechanism of missed signs.

structural_cues: 47:36 places the nearer life, purposeless activity, and diversion together near the surah's close.
The focus contrast between already-arrived signs and continued waiting requires some account of what holds attention elsewhere; 47:36 supplies one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies nearness, purposeless activity, diversion, waiting, and directed attention; I infer that near attractions actively maintain the delay. A live alternative is that 47:36 offers a general valuation of worldly life without explaining the specific perception failure in 47:18.

changed_reading.before: Waiting is a passive lack of urgency.
changed_reading.after: Waiting is actively maintained by attention captured by nearer pursuits, so the audience can remain busy while failing to read signs already present.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reverses the surface subject-object relation by activating a branch in which time's gaze destroys a people, so it is surprising and reader-supplied. It remains anchored in the focus looking root and is reinforced by the surrounding destructive and death-like gazes; downstream prose should present it only as a reversible personification, not as the clause's primary syntax.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places the human looking root directly against the temporal noun at word 4, allowing a contained reversal of who ultimately looks upon whom.

activation_trace.role: A fatal gaze attributed to time supplies the reversal from people watching the event to time overtaking the people.
Erasure of prior peoples gives the personified gaze a visible historical result.
The visibly altered gaze shows the human observers already bearing the effect of what they try to watch.

changed_reading.before: People stand outside time and watch for its decisive event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the temporal event is already looking back and marking its observers; their apparent surveillance masks that they are the ones under its fatal regard.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The rare branch connecting the focus temporal root with the perished is lexically distant from the ordinary reading and cannot replace it. It remains anchored at word 4 and gains coherence from contextual annihilation, complete taking, and death among groups; downstream prose should qualify it as a secondary resonance in which the Hour arrives as a human state or company, not assert a different lexical definition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The noun at word 4 carries the rare perished-people branch, while the two coming constructions let that state enter the audience's present.

activation_trace.role: The rare association with the perished lets the event be heard as a collective human condition as well as a time.
Falling into extinction supplies an earlier collective instance of that condition.
Complete taking shows how the collective state is entered one person at a time.
Death occurring among people or property gives the resonance a group-level field.

changed_reading.before: The Hour is only an abstract future time-point.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, it is also the arriving state or company of the perished, already foreshadowed by collective destruction and individual taking.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This concretizes the signs as marked personnel or an advance detachment, which is stranger than reading them as indicators. It remains anchored in the sign root's selected-guard branch and is contextually activated by angelic and messenger agents; downstream prose should keep it as a martial-governance image of advance arrival, not identify any specific agents as the signs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Word 10 can denote a marked selected force, and its prior coming at word 9 precedes the second coming at word 14.

activation_trace.role: A marked selected guard supplies the image of signs as an advance detachment of authority.
The repeated arrival pattern lets an advance element precede the main arrival.
Angelic executors provide one contextual model of authority arriving through agents.
Messenger and message supply another context form in which a larger authority arrives in advance through representation.

changed_reading.before: The signs are impersonal indicators of an absent event.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the signs resemble the event's marked advance detachment: authority has already entered representationally before arriving in full.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This links the final warning of social replacement to the focus Hour through a branch of the people-root involving rising and the Hour, so it is cross-domain and cannot bear a primary reading. It remains anchored by the focus preliminaries and by replacement with another people standing in place; downstream prose should frame it as social rehearsal or miniature, not equate political succession with the final event.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus distinguishes preliminaries already arrived from a main arrival still pending, leaving room for contextual processes that rehearse the final pattern.

activation_trace.role: Preliminary stages allow an earlier social process to anticipate a later comprehensive rising.
A summons supplies the decision point before replacement occurs.
The split mapping adds a forceful call or rebuke, preserving the summons even under the secondary root resolution.
Turning away provides the social failure that triggers substitution.
One entity standing in another's place supplies the replacement mechanism.
Standing in for another makes the new people a concrete enactment of substitution.
The rising-and-Hour branch creates the surprising bridge from social replacement to final rising.

changed_reading.before: Only cosmic portents can count as preliminaries to the Hour.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, a people being summoned, turning away, and being replaced can socially rehearse the larger pattern of summons, displacement, and rising.

strongest_changes: 47:10 changes apparent waiting into refusal to inspect an already-available archive of outcomes.
47:16-17 makes late remembrance path-dependent: meaningful reception can accumulate, while failed reception can harden into closure before crisis.
47:20 supplies a local rehearsal in which decisive mention already produces the gaze and cognitive collapse associated with death.
47:27 personalizes the no-return threshold through complete taking, while 47:29-31 makes present signs diagnostic disclosures of latent inner states.
47:33-35 keeps an exploratory procedural reading alive in which records and works can retain or lose operative standing before settlement.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse sustained several non-equivalent mechanisms at once: a temporal deadline after notice, failed evidential inspection, path-dependent memory, embodied diagnostic marks, a distributed flowing approach, and a procedurally late claim. The most unusual live resonances reversed the gaze toward the observers, heard the Hour through the perished, concretized signs as an advance detachment, and treated social replacement as a rehearsal of rising.
remaining_uncertainties: The rare perished-people branch of س و ع may be only lexical resonance and should not displace the ordinary temporal noun.
The hydrological model may be a productive material analogy rather than a mechanism asserted by the context.
The documentary branch of ذ ك ر supports procedural language, but the verse may intend recollection without any claim-or-record nuance.
47:27 may instantiate the focus deadline through personal death, or it may remain a separate scene without narrowing the universal Hour.
The causal direction between repeated delay and locked cognition remains open: delay may produce closure, reveal prior closure, or do both.
